summary: Elutia Inc. filed an 8-K reporting entry into an Asset Purchase Agreement to sell its SimpliDerm Business (human acellular dermis products for breast reconstruction) to Cellution Biologics Inc. Consideration is up to $11M comprising $8M cash base purchase price at closing (subject to inventory adjustment), a $2M milestone payment for technology transfer/manufacturing transition within 18 months, and up to $1M in earn-out payments based on quarterly revenue targets over five quarters post-closing. The board recommendation is not stated; no advisors are named. The agreement includes a five-year non-compete on hADM products and a transition services agreement. What to watch: completion of technology transfer milestones and monthly sales targets to trigger contingent payments.
